gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-headland-one: Commanding from the first glance, Wallpoet cuts its letters with a line of paper showing through. Headland One follows in a dignified serif, its widely spaced letters and gentle weight shifts softening the heading's hard edge.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-hedvig-letters-serif: Wallpoet is all bold stencil-like gaps and smooth curves. Hedvig Letters Serif adds the weight of a classic serif, with sturdy lowercase and medium-key contrast, so the loud heading has something solid to stand on.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-lisu-bosa: Classic and editorial, Lisu Bosa sets sturdy tall lowercase with spill-out counters. Wallpoet does its best work as a bold, gapped display line, while Lisu Bosa does its best as the text serif with a lightly flexed contrast.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-marcellus-sc: Wallpoet's thin channel of paper cutting through every letter is its most arresting habit, and the lowercase rises high. Marcellus SC meets it with the weight of a classic serif, dignified and literary.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-montagu-slab: Montagu Slab is a traditional, refined serif with robust downstrokes and slender turns, built on a sizable x-height. Montagu Slab gives Wallpoet's bold, smoothly curved display lines a steady, readable partner underneath.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-noto-serif-hentaigana: Refined and traditional, Noto Serif Hentaigana has open curves and small letters nearly as tall as capitals. Give that classic serif a generous size, and let Wallpoet's bold heading do the shouting.
gen-gf-wallpoet-gf-ovo: Wallpoet hits hard with its gapped, bold letters, while Ovo stays classic and authoritative with a tall middle band. Ovo's thick and thin strokes sit close, so the text serif keeps going without strain.
gen-gf-warnes-fs-bespoke-slab: Warnes tapers its ink strokes out before they touch, with stretched, spacious tracking and no stroke contrast at all. Bespoke Slab is the grounded serif that follows, its tall lowercase giving the heading's loose drawing something firm.
gen-gf-warnes-fs-erode: Warnes draws every stroke with no contrast at all, giving it a texture of plain, unshaded lines. Erode joins it as a classic serif, with a tempered thick-thin variation that never thins to razor hairlines.
gen-gf-warnes-fs-hoover: Lines that keep their width through every turn, tapering before they touch, mark Warnes out. And Hoover, a refined text serif with a generous e and compressed ascenders, can run a touch larger to hold its own.
